module: Vendor Ops Context: Daily Settlements, Menu Photo Upload & Audit Trail

stateMachineCertification.detail: Sequential transitions enforced: CONFIRMED -> PREPARING -> ALMOST_READY -> READY_FOR_PICKUP -> PICKED_UP. Skipping states rejected (CONFIRMED -> ALMOST_READY blocked). Advance from terminal state returns 400 INVALID_TRANSITION.
testedCases: CONFIRMED -> PREPARING generates 4-digit OTP + UUID QR token

websocketCertification.detail: initWebSocketServer wired into index.ts via server.on('upgrade'). publishStatusUpdate emits { event: 'ORDER_STATUS_UPDATE', data: { order_id, sql_status, ui_status, restaurant_id, timestamp } } on every transition. Redis PubSub channel 'order_updates' for cross-instance broadcast; MemoryRedis no-op seam in dev/test.
testedCases: WebSocket server started on API HTTP server

checkInCertification.detail: POST /api/v1/orders/:id/check-in records consumer arrival (checked_in=true). Idempotent - repeat check-in returns success. Requires authentication (401 UNAUTHORIZED without token).

confirmPickupCertification.detail: POST /api/v1/orders/:id/confirm-pickup verifies 4-digit OTP or UUID QR token. Rejects invalid OTP (INVALID_OTP), invalid QR (INVALID_QR), pickup before READY_FOR_PICKUP (NOT_READY), missing verification method (VALIDATION_ERROR), and duplicate pickup (ALREADY_PICKED_UP).

vendorCertification.detail: PUT /api/vendor/orders/:id/status advances state machine and returns next status + pickup_otp + qr_token. GET /api/vendor/orders?restaurant_id= returns active orders (excludes PICKED_UP/CANCELLED/PAYMENT_FAILED/DRAFT/PAYMENT_PENDING).
testedCases: Status advance returns next status and OTP/QR
Vendor order listing returns active orders

settlementCertification.detail: V11 settlement engine computes commission PER ORDER from total_amount (0% <= Rs 200, 8% above), recomputes taxes deterministically from persisted order_items (GST 5% food, 18% packaging, Rs 10/item packaging) and settles PICKED_UP/SETTLED orders in the previous UTC day. GET /api/vendor/settlements/summary returns JSON totals; PUT /api/vendor/settlements/today streams a real PDF (%PDF- magic, Content-Disposition attachment) and writes a settlement_downloaded audit row.
testedCases: GST recomputed from items (5% food, 18% packaging, Rs 10/item)
Low-value payout = total - taxes; high-value 8% commission on total_amount
Summary route filters by previous day + restaurant + status
PDF route returns application/pdf with correct filename

menuPhotoCertification.detail: V13 photo upload accepts multipart image (jpeg/png/webp/gif, max 5MB) via multer memory storage, uploads through the ImageStorage abstraction (S3 backend or deterministic mock CDN URL), persists image_url on menu_items (new migration 0002_vendor_ops.sql), and writes a menu_photo_uploaded audit row. Menu management: GET /api/vendor/menu lists all items incl. unavailable + image_url; PUT /api/vendor/menu/:itemId updates price/availability and audits; vendor updates are immediately visible to the consumer catalog via the shared repository singleton.
testedCases: Upload returns CDN URL matching mock key pattern
image_url persisted and returned by vendor menu listing
menu_photo_uploaded audit row written with size_bytes
Menu update audited (menu_updated with changed fields)
Vendor is_available=false hides item from consumer menu

frontendCertification.detail: Consumer: /orders/[id] tracking page with live WebSocket status via OrderTracker timeline, QR code + OTP shown at READY_FOR_PICKUP, check-in button, picked-up confirmation. GET /api/v1/orders/:id (auth + ownership check) added so tracking page loads order data. Vendor: Next.js app on port 3002 with kitchen dashboard - pending/ready order lists, status advance buttons, OTP entry for pickup confirmation, live WebSocket subscription. Both apps: next build succeeds, tsc clean.

notes: OTP (4-digit) + QR token (UUID) generated at CONFIRMED -> PREPARING transition, stored via setPickupOtp and re-read before response.

WebSocket contract follows EOS Layer 1: { event: 'ORDER_STATUS_UPDATE', data: { order_id, sql_status, ui_status, restaurant_id, timestamp } }. Consumers subscribe to order:{orderId}, vendors to restaurant:{restaurantId}. Verified live: broadcast received on advance (PREPARING).
Cross-instance broadcast uses Redis PubSub channel 'order_updates'. MemoryRedis seam (no-op duplicate/publish/subscribe) enables dev/test without live Redis.
Consumer page wraps in AuthGate + Next.js middleware protects /checkout and /orders/:path*.
QrCode component renders Teal SVG with finder patterns; production would use a qrcode library.
Total tests: 102 (P1-007) + 16 (P1-008 fulfillment) + 3 (GET order) = 121 across 15 files.
Config: REDIS_URL/JWT_SECRET/MSG91_AUTH_KEY relaxed to optional-with-default so the API boots without live Redis/SMS in dev preview.
Dev-mode OTP bypass: any 6-digit OTP accepted when NODE_ENV is development (matches consumer login page 'use any 6 digits' hint). Production/tests still verify strictly.
